messages:
anita: Heads-up — I'm prototyping a small 'requant' pass that runs right after decoding but before KV writeback so we can smooth outputs when switching precision lanes. low-risk hotpatch idea. :thinking:
joel: Can you sketch the invariants? is this for runtime-only fallbacks or persistent profile changes?
dmitri: Quick note: changing representations mid-request is tricky for KV cache. we need a canonical serialization or cache versioning tag.
sophia: Agree with dmitri. Also need quality checks: small prompt set replay or token-level confidence delta. If delta > threshold, trigger rollback.
anita: Right — design idea: requant step is pure transform on logits/activations -> quantized representation used for subsequent decodes. We keep original fp32/FP8 in RAM until commit. If quick validation fails, we skip commit and keep previous lane for that session.
carter: Sounds good. Latency hit? hotpath needs <0.5ms ideally. How heavy is the validation?
anita: Validation is a tiny bloom of prompts (3 short prompts) ran in async but blocking the commit. We can also do an optimistic commit and serve with fallback route if regressions noticed in telemetry.
joel: If cache entries are tagged with "quant-version", then fallback can have the runtime remap keys -> avoid mismatch. need schema change in kv meta.
dmitri: Implementation detail: do not mutate KV layout. instead store a sidecar delta: {quant-v: X, checksum: Y}. On lookup, runtime applies delta to restore expected dtype. avoids large GC churn.
anita: Example config snippet I was thinking of (pseudo):
```
requant: {
  enabled: true,
  quick_checks: ["short_prompts_v1"],
  max_latency_ms: 1,
  cache_mode: "sidecar"
}
```
sophia: Two operational concerns: (1) telemetry to attribute quality regressions to the requant pass, (2) ability to turn off per-customer or per-endpoint.
carter: Also QA — need a canary plan. small percent of traffic, compare against baseline model and run auto-eval during traffic window.
anita: Proposed rollout: dev branch -> internal canary (5%) with strict alerting -> expanded canary with sampled prompt replay -> opt-in beta customers -> full rollout. Hotpatch path: deploy as a non-breaking config flag so we can flip it on with runtime config.
joel: One more: how do we handle mixed-precision layers? e.g., attention in FP8 but MLP in int4. Requant should be per-layer granularity and produce a compact descriptor.
dmitri: descriptor looks like list of (layer, quant-mode, checksum). keep it small.
ml-bot: perf-ci: quick-bench queued for branch "requant/mini" — expect results in ~30m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
deploy-bot: deploy queued: staging -> will notify on success.
anita: Thanks — I'll update the RFC follow-up doc with interface sketch and a section for KV sidecar spec. tagging @joel @dmitri for review before I push the branch. :rocket:
carter: if you need ops help with alerts or SLO knobs, ping ops-oncall.
anita: Will do.
